coordinator_message: Coordinator: your BINARY_V4 edits still write payload[0] = 2 in malformed test. This is unchecked indexing and is explicitly forbidden. Use literal [2, 0] (version2 with malformed too-short body), or Vec from postcard-encoded 2u16 extended with a literal array; no index writes. Also there is still pub with_policy_pin plus new #[allow(clippy::missing_inline_in_public_items)] from earlier unaccepted V1: do not add suppressions. That trust boundary will be repaired in next task; report it as remaining. Do not claim child complete. Only focused new tests/doc cleanup now.
